passages.source: Buying a property in Bulgaria: guidance (demo summary, illustrative)
passages.text: Buyer and seller usually sign a preliminary contract before the notary deed: it fixes the price, the deposit, the deadline for the deed and what happens if either side backs out. The notary deed itself is signed later, before a notary.

My fixed fee for drafting a preliminary contract includes a check of the property register for encumbrances and one round of changes with the other side. Attending the notary deed is billed separately.
